weekly_theme.summary: 這段期間沒有特別重大的星象事件，是適合按自己步調安排生活的一週。

aries.horoscope: 白羊座，無論你目前正在職涯、個人項目或社區服務中追求什麼，都將為你帶來深刻的滿足感。你喜歡你的活動，產生積極的影響，並與新的熟人建立聯繫。你的活力閃耀著光芒，你可能會覺得無敵。請注意可能會出現的小打嗝，但請放心，它們不會抑制你的精神。
aries.horoscope_en: Aries, whatever endeavors you're currently pursuing—be it in your career, personal projects, or community service—are set to bring you a deep sense of fulfillment. You're relishing your activities, making a positive impact, and connecting with new acquaintances. Your vitality is shining bright, and you might feel invincible. Just be mindful of small hiccups that could arise, but rest assured, they won't dampen your spirits.

taurus.horoscope: 金牛座，看來你的個人和創意界限正在擴大。今天可以從你自己或他人的藝術努力中獲得豐厚的回報。你可能會遇到一些人，他們不僅是有價值的人際關係，而且還是潛在的新朋友。你們的浪漫關係正在蓬勃發展，這種新發現的熱情和自信感肯定對你有利！
taurus.horoscope_en: Taurus, it seems your personal and creative boundaries are broadening. Today could bring significant rewards from your own or someone else's artistic endeavors. You may meet individuals who turn out to be not only valuable connections but also potential new friends. Your romantic relationships are thriving, and this newfound sense of enthusiasm and self-assurance is definitely working in your favor!

gemini.horoscope: 今天是聚會的絕佳機會，無論是在您的房源還是好友的雙子座。這個活動可能會演變成超越單純享受的東西。引人入勝的討論可能會導致您建立重要的商業或社交聯繫。無論您有什麼計劃，都可以期待未來美好的一天！
gemini.horoscope_en: Today presents a great opportunity for a gathering, whether at your place or a friend's, Gemini. This event could evolve into something beyond mere enjoyment. Engaging discussions may lead you to forge important business or social connections. Regardless of your plans, anticipate a delightful day ahead!
gemini.lucky_disclaimer: 幸運色／幸運時間由本 App 依星座與日期自動生成，非真實命理來源，僅供參考娛樂。

cancer.horoscope: 準備好迎接你所在社區的積極轉型浪潮吧，巨蟹座。你可能會看到新商店湧現、有趣的新面孔搬進來，或最終完成重要的翻新工程。當您分享最新資訊時，無論是開車還是通話，都可以隨時隨地出門。一個令人興奮的機會可能會降臨在你的膝蓋上，或者通過信件、電子郵件或電話與你附近的人聯繫。
cancer.horoscope_en: Get ready for a wave of positive transformations in your neighborhood, Cancer. You might see new shops popping up, intriguing new faces moving in, or essential renovations finally being completed. Expect to be on the go, whether it's driving around or chatting on the phone, as you share the latest updates. An exciting opportunity could land in your lap or reach someone close to you via a letter, email, or call.

leo.horoscope: Leo ，你可能經歷過一些金融和商業企業的起起落落。然而，一個重要的轉捩點似乎即將到來。今天可能是交易的開始或結束，這將對您的財務狀況產生重大影響。預計您的貨幣狀況不僅會增強，還會達到新的穩定水平。憑藉您的辛勤工作和奉獻精神，這一積極趨勢將持續下去。
leo.horoscope_en: Leo, you've likely experienced some ups and downs in your financial and business ventures. However, it appears that a significant turning point is on the horizon. Today could mark the beginning or conclusion of a deal that will greatly impact your financial landscape. Expect your monetary situation to not only enhance but also reach a new level of stability. With your hard work and dedication, this positive trend is set to persist.
leo.lucky_disclaimer: 幸運色／幸運時間由本 App 依星座與日期自動生成，非真實命理來源，僅供參考娛樂。

virgo.horoscope: 作為處女座，您的自然傾向傾向於實用性和商業頭腦的方法。然而，你最近取得的重大進展可能會放大你保持理智和效率以維持這一勢頭的衝動。你正在散發積極和樂觀的情緒，這種令人振奮的能量可能會持續下去。唯一的問題是，你可能會發現自己付出了很多努力。但請放心，結果將是有益的，所以接受挑戰吧！
virgo.horoscope_en: As a Virgo, your natural inclination leans towards practicality and a business-minded approach. However, the significant progress you've made recently might amplify your urge to remain sensible and efficient to sustain this momentum. You're radiating positivity and optimism, and this uplifting energy is likely to persist. The only catch is that you may find yourself putting in a lot of effort. But rest assured, the outcomes will be rewarding, so embrace the challenge!

libra.horoscope: 天秤座，您可能認為自己是知識的追求者，但您職業生涯和財務方面的最新發展揭示了商業和財務管理方面的隱藏技能。這一時期的特點不僅是成功和繁榮，還有寶貴的自我發現。抵制回歸過去不安全感或淡化自己能力的衝動。你擁有實現遠遠超出你所意識到的潛力。
libra.horoscope_en: Libra, you may see yourself as a seeker of knowledge, but recent developments in your career and finances have unveiled hidden skills in business and money management. This period has not only been marked by success and prosperity but also by valuable self-discovery. Resist the urge to revert to past insecurities or to downplay your abilities. You possess the potential to achieve far more than you realize.

scorpio.horoscope: 天蠍座，你今天天生的魅力因新發現的自信而增強。參與團體活動或社交聚會可以讓您與事實證明是重要職業盟友的個人建立聯繫。由於對你的願景有信心的人的支持，你一直在追求的野心可能會開始成形。擁抱這一天的積極性；它擁有快樂和成功的巨大潛力。抓住時機！
scorpio.horoscope_en: Scorpio, your innate charm is amplified today by a newfound self-assurance. Engaging in group activities or social gatherings could connect you with individuals who turn out to be significant professional allies. The ambitions you've been pursuing may start to take shape, thanks to the support of those who have faith in your vision. Embrace the positivity of this day; it holds great potential for joy and success. Seize the moment!

sagittarius.horoscope: 今天，射手座，你可能會發現自己在質疑自己經歷的真實性。一波又一波的成功和繁榮正在向你走來，路上只有幾個小小的顛簸。您在商業、財務和職業方面的努力有望取得顯著成就，即使對未來的擔憂仍然存在。無需煩惱，只需擁抱旅程，讓事情自然展開。
sagittarius.horoscope_en: Today, Sagittarius, you may find yourself questioning the reality of your experiences. A wave of success and prosperity is heading your way, with only a few small bumps in the road to navigate. Your endeavors in business, finances, and career are poised for remarkable achievements, even if a hint of apprehension about the future lingers. There's no need to fret—just embrace the journey and let things unfold naturally.

capricorn.horoscope: 摩羯座，你在事業和財務上的成就為你打開了一些最深切的願望之門。無論是追求高等教育，沉浸在不同的文化中，還是進入寫作和出版領域，現在都是採取行動的最佳時機。隨著你的日程安排比以往任何時候都更加順暢，請抓住這個機會開始計劃下一步！
capricorn.horoscope_en: Capricorn, your achievements in your career and finances are opening doors to some of your deepest aspirations. Whether it's pursuing higher education, immersing yourself in different cultures, or venturing into writing and publishing, now is the perfect moment to take action. With your schedule more accommodating than ever, seize this opportunity to start planning your next steps!

aquarius.horoscope: 水瓶座，憑藉你業務和財務的新穩定感，你可能會發現自己被吸引去探索你的精神和形而上學的好奇心。你的直覺和心靈感官可能會增強，導致生動的夢想和強大的見解。參與書籍和線上講座可以為您帶來深刻的啟發。
aquarius.horoscope_en: With a newfound sense of stability in your business and finances, Aquarius, you may find yourself drawn to explore your spiritual and metaphysical curiosities. Your intuition and psychic senses are likely heightened, leading to vivid dreams and powerful insights. Engaging with books and online lectures could offer you profound enlightenment.

pisces.horoscope: 雙魚座，幾乎在你生活的方方面面都在尋找你。預期你的職涯、財務和合作會有積極的發展，這一切都指向成功。你的人際關係，特別是在浪漫中，將為你帶來更大的快樂和滿足。您可能會發現自己正在考慮新的事業或教育追求，以擴大您的經驗。充滿信心地把握這些機會！
pisces.horoscope_en: Things are looking up for you in nearly every aspect of your life, Pisces. Expect positive developments in your career, finances, and collaborations, all pointing towards success. Your personal connections, especially in romance, are set to bring you greater joy and fulfillment. You may find yourself contemplating new ventures or educational pursuits to broaden your experiences. Embrace these opportunities with confidence!
